title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Explore the corridors and blocks surrounding the CUNY Queens College campus, from the bustling shops of Kissena Boulevard to the transit hubs of Flushing.

cards.title: The Classic Pizza Corner
cards.subtitle: Kissena Boulevard & 65th Avenue
cards.notes: Grab a slice at this neighborhood staple located directly across from the campus main gate, a frequent stop for students between classes.
cards.short_summary: A long-standing pizzeria located at the intersection of Kissena Boulevard and 65th Avenue, serving the Queens College community.
cards.evidence_claim: Gino's of Kissena is located at 65-01 Kissena Blvd, directly opposite the Queens College campus, and is a popular local dining spot for students.
cards.source_title: Gino's Pizza – The Best Pizza in Flushing
cards.access_notes: Open daily for walk-in orders and dining.

cards.title: The South Campus Slice
cards.subtitle: Kissena Boulevard & 71st Avenue
cards.notes: Walk south from the Student Union to find this local alternative for pizza and Italian entrees, often less crowded than spots closer to the main gate.
cards.short_summary: A family-owned pizzeria and restaurant located south of the main campus on Kissena Boulevard.
cards.evidence_claim: Valentino's Pizzeria and Restaurant is located at 71-47 Kissena Blvd, approximately a 10-15 minute walk south of the Queens College Student Union.
cards.access_notes: Accessible via a short walk or the Q25/Q34 bus lines.

cards.title: Boba and Sushi Break
cards.subtitle: Kissena Boulevard & 60th Avenue
cards.notes: Visit this modern spot for bubble tea and sushi rolls, a popular hangout for students from both Queens College and nearby Townsend Harris.
cards.short_summary: A contemporary Japanese restaurant and tea bar located north of the campus on Kissena Boulevard.
cards.evidence_claim: Qiu Sushi & Tea Bar is located at 60-05 Kissena Boulevard and is noted by student media as a popular spot for bubble tea and snacks near campus.
cards.source_title: Can't We All Just Get Oolong? Harrisites review Kissena Boulevard's Qiu Sushi, Ramen, & Tea Bar - The Classic
cards.access_notes: Indoor seating available; located near the Q17 and Q88 bus stops.

cards.title: Cantonese Comfort Food
cards.subtitle: Kissena Boulevard & 60th Street
cards.notes: Stop by for roast meats over rice and other Cantonese specialties at this local eatery situated just north of the Long Island Expressway.
cards.short_summary: A Cantonese restaurant offering traditional dishes and lunch specials near the northern edge of the campus area.
cards.evidence_claim: MJ USA (東旺飯店) is located at 60-10 Kissena Blvd and is recognized for its Cantonese cuisine and roast meats.
cards.source_title: M & J USA Restaurant in Queens / Menus & Photos - WhereYouEat.com
cards.access_notes: Open daily for takeout and dine-in.

cards.title: The Athletics Corridor
cards.subtitle: Main Street & Reeves Avenue
cards.notes: Access the college's athletic fields and gymnasium through this gate, located on the western edge of campus near the Main Street commercial strip.
cards.short_summary: The western entrance to the Queens College campus, providing access to the Fitzgerald Gymnasium and athletic facilities.
cards.evidence_claim: The Fitzgerald Gymnasium is located on Reeves Avenue between Main Street and Kissena Boulevard, with a campus gate servicing the area.
cards.access_notes: Pedestrian access available during campus operating hours.

cards.title: Off-Campus Study Space
cards.subtitle: Main Street & 72nd Avenue
cards.notes: Find a quiet place to work at this public library branch, located a short walk from the southern end of the campus in Kew Gardens Hills.
cards.short_summary: A branch of the Queens Public Library serving the Kew Gardens Hills neighborhood near Queens College.
cards.evidence_claim: The Kew Gardens Hills branch of the Queens Public Library is located at 72-33 Vleigh Place, near the intersection of Main Street and 72nd Avenue.
cards.source_title: Kew Gardens Hills - Queens Public Library
cards.access_notes: Free public access; check library website for current operating hours.

cards.title: Neighborhood Green Space
cards.subtitle: Vleigh Place & 77th Avenue
cards.notes: Relax at this local park located just south of the campus, offering basketball courts and open space for students living in Kew Gardens Hills.
cards.short_summary: A public park and playground located in the Kew Gardens Hills neighborhood south of Queens College.
cards.evidence_claim: Queens Valley Playground is located at Vleigh Place and 77th Avenue in Kew Gardens Hills, providing recreational facilities for the community.
cards.access_notes: Open to the public daily from dawn to dusk.

cards.title: The Transit Connection
cards.subtitle: Main Street & Roosevelt Avenue
cards.notes: Take the college shuttle or a city bus to this major transit hub for access to the 7 train and the diverse food scene of downtown Flushing.
cards.short_summary: The central intersection of downtown Flushing, serving as a primary transit link for Queens College students.
cards.evidence_claim: The Flushing-Main Street station is a major transit hub connected to Queens College via the Q25 and Q17 bus lines and the college's own shuttle service.
cards.access_notes: 24-hour public transit access; shuttle service hours vary by semester.

cards.title: The Southern Gateway
cards.subtitle: Union Turnpike & Vleigh Place
cards.notes: Explore the shops and restaurants along this major thoroughfare, which connects the campus area to the Kew Gardens-Union Turnpike subway station.
cards.short_summary: A commercial corridor south of the campus featuring various dining and retail options for the local community.
cards.evidence_claim: Union Turnpike is a major southern border of the Kew Gardens Hills neighborhood and a key transit route for students accessing the E and F subway lines.
cards.access_notes: Accessible via the Q46 bus line from the campus area.

cards.title: The Eastern Edge
cards.subtitle: Parsons Boulevard & 75th Avenue
cards.notes: Discover local delis and convenience stores along this stretch, located just east of the campus and accessible via the Q25 bus.
cards.short_summary: A residential and commercial area on the eastern side of the Queens College campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Parsons Boulevard is a major north-south road in Queens that runs east of the Queens College campus and features local businesses serving the area.
cards.source_title: PARSONS BOULEVARD, Flushing-Jamaica - Forgotten New York
cards.access_notes: Accessible via the Q25 bus line which stops near the campus.
